companyDescription.title: Company Description
companyDescription.text: Founded in the year 2009 with the aim of promoting the provision of high-quality education in Saudi Arabia. The founders of QEC all shared the common objective of wishing to invest in education with a view to making a difference. The owners are motivated by their desire to ensure all learners are given the best opportunities to maximize their potential.

jobDescription.title: Job Description
jobDescription.text: Since its foundation in 2009, QEC is working with the most prestigious universities in KSA. We are looking to expand once again. We are hiring 100 English language teachers for the academic year 2022 - 2023. Those who are looking for new challenges and great experiences, come join us today and unveil your gateway to success.

qualifications.title: Qualifications
qualifications.text:
• Citizen of USA, UK, Canada, Australia, Ireland, and New Zealand
  • Bachelor’s degree
  • CELTA or DELTA
  • ESL teaching experience

additionalInformation.title: Additional Information
additionalInformation.text:
• Tax-free Salary
  • Medical Insurance
  • Round trip tickets
  • Paid annual vacation
  • Visa cost is covered
  • Covid-19 tests and quarantine are covered

jobDescription.title: Job Description
jobDescription.text: The position entails teaching English language skills such as ( reading, writing, speaking) to a class of 30 to 35 adult students with ages ranging between 18-20 using the preset curriculum (Headway or Unlock) and teaching resources provided by the university.

qualifications.title: Qualifications
qualifications.text:
Female candidates only ( Native English speaking teachers only; USA-Canada-Australia - UK - Ireland-South Africa )

Ø  BA or MA (Teaching English, Applied Linguistics or ESL are preferred)

Ø  CELTA/DELTA or equivalent ESL teaching certification.

Ø  Online qualifications are NOT accepted.

Ø  Minimum 2 years of teaching ESL to adults

Ø  IMMEDIATE start (ready to start in 7 days).
